issues.detail: The Hebrew 'נֶגֶד הָעֶשְׂרִים אֲשֶׁר לֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִי' means 'opposite the twenty [chambers] that belonged to the inner court', not 'facing the twenty courtyards of the inner court'. The Chinese adds '院子' (courtyards) which is not in the Hebrew; the 'twenty' refers to chambers/rooms, not courtyards. This changes the referent.
